import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { TaskService } from '../../services/task.service'; import { TaskCardComponent } from '../task-card/task-card.component'; /** * 3-Zone Visual Priority Dashboard Canvas. * Standardized uniform grid layout (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3`) across all 3 zones. * Zero emojis - clean executive presentation. */ @Component({ selector: 'app-canvas', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, TaskCardComponent], template: `
{{ taskService.errorMessage() }}

Calculating Dynamic Priora Scores...

Focus Zone

Score ≥ 80.0
{{ taskService.focusZoneTasks().length }} Critical Tasks
No critical tasks in the Focus Zone.

Drifting Zone

Score 50.0 - 79.9
{{ taskService.driftingZoneTasks().length }} Active Tasks
No active tasks in the Drifting Zone.

Orbit Zone

Score < 50.0 / Done
{{ taskService.orbitZoneTasks().length }} Backlog / Completed Tasks
No backlog or completed tasks in the Orbit Zone.
` }) export class CanvasComponent implements OnInit { constructor(public taskService: TaskService) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.taskService.loadTasks(); } }
